card.name: Danger, damage and enable words
card.fires_on: Fires on a few specific words such as danger, damage, enable and stage, often as the start of a word like Dangerous or Enable. It appears in general web text, not label text.

modes.label: Danger words
modes.description: The word danger or its start in dangerous, or the word damage, in general prose.
